title: Iki plugin lockfile (iki/v1)
description: A deployment's `plugins.lock.yaml`: every plugin it installs, each pinned to a git commit.

plugins.description: The plugins, each once. The core plugin comes with Iki and isn't listed.

name.description: The plugin's name, as its plugin.yaml gives it.

git.description: The plugin's git repository: an https or ssh URL, such as `https://github.com/acme/iki-plugins.git` or `git@github.com:acme/iki-plugins.git`.

sha.description: The commit to install, in full: 40 hex digits (64 for SHA-256 repositories). Branches and tags can move, so they aren't accepted.

path.description: The plugin's directory inside the repository, if it isn't the root, such as `plugins/dna`.

local.description: For development only: the plugin's directory on this machine, relative to the lockfile. `iki deploy build` refuses it without `--allow-local`, and a production server refuses to start with it.

settings.description: The deployment's values for the plugin's settings: a YAML file, relative to the lockfile.

plugin.description: A plugin from git (`git` and `sha`, and `path` if it isn't at the repository's root), or, for development, from a directory (`local`).
